# Warsaw Masonry Supply

> Family-owned masonry and hardscape supply yard in Warsaw, Indiana (Kosciusko County), serving Northern Indiana since 1966. Authorized Unilock dealer and Allan Block dealer stocking brick, natural and manufactured stone, pavers, retaining wall systems, outdoor kitchen and fireplace materials, and wood and gas stoves — with free material consultations and quantity estimates for homeowners and contractors.

- Address: 1403 N Detroit St, Warsaw, IN 46580
- Phone: 574.267.2825
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM–5:00 PM; closed Saturday, Sunday and major holidays
- Service area: Warsaw, Winona Lake, Columbia City, Mentone, Akron, North Manchester, Rochester, Peru, Goshen and all of Kosciusko County, Indiana
- Customers: homeowners, contractors, builders, landscapers, masons and commercial projects
- Brands: Unilock (authorized dealer), Allan Block, Belden Brick, Buechel Stone, Delgado Stone, Natural Stone Veneers International (NSVI), Dutch Quality Stone, Cultured Stone, Champlain Stone, Halquist Stone
- Memberships: Kosciusko Chamber of Commerce; Builders Association of North Central Indiana
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=3858331614010352909 (4.5 stars, 33 reviews)

## Common questions

- What does Warsaw Masonry Supply sell? Brick, natural stone, manufactured stone, pavers, retaining wall systems, hardscape materials, outdoor kitchen materials, outdoor fireplaces, and wood and gas stoves.
- Who does it serve? Homeowners, contractors, builders, landscapers, masons and commercial projects across Kosciusko County and Northern Indiana.
- Is it an authorized Unilock dealer? Yes — an authorized Unilock dealer and an Allan Block dealer.
- Does it estimate materials? Yes — free quantity estimates based on your measurements, product choice and application.
- How do I get started? Call 574.267.2825 or request a free quote at https://www.warsawmasonry.com/contact.
